<|channel|>analysis<|message|>We need to identify which description is right based on the work on government in 2021 given the long report. Let's read each option.

Option A: "China has made progress in the following six fronts: employment, financial sector, foreign trade, basic living needs, food and energy security and expectations." In the report, early on it describes "six fronts" in context: In paragraph about macro policies: "based on what we had done to ensure stability on six key fronts, we carried out the task of maintaining security in six key areas—particularly job security, basic living needs, and the operations of market entities." Wait: The "six fronts" are employment, financial sector, foreign trade, foreign investment, domestic investment and expectations. That matches the description. But the text says "employment, financial sector, foreign trade, foreign investment, domestic investment, and expectations." But Option A lists employment, financial sector, foreign trade, basic living needs, food and energy security, and expectations. That includes basic living needs (one of the six areas? different) and food and energy security (one of six areas? actually six areas: job security, basic living needs, operations of market entities, food and energy security, stable industrial and supply chains, normal functioning of primary-level governments). Option A mixes fronts and areas incorrectly. The description in the report mentions "six key fronts" (employment, financial sector, foreign trade, foreign investment, domestic investment, and expectations). So Option A is partially correct but also includes food and energy security and basic living needs which are six key areas. Option states "six fronts: employment, financial sector, foreign trade, basic living needs, food and energy security and expectations." That is not exactly described. The front list includes food and energy security? No. But the report's six fronts include foreign trade, foreign investment, domestic investment, not food and energy security. So Option A is not correct.

Option B: "Among the main projected targets for development in 2021, the following aims are included: creating over 11 million new jobs, making GDP growth for over 6 percent, reducing the energy consumption per GDP for less than 3 percent, and curbing the unemployment rate to around 6.5 percent." Let's check. The report: "The main projected targets for this year ... GDP growth of over 6 percent, over 11 million new urban jobs, a surveyed urban unemployment rate of around 5.5 percent (not 6.5), CPI increase of around 3 percent, steady increases in imports/exports, etc. Energy consumption per GDP: reduce by around 3 percent? It says "a drop of around 3 percent in energy consumption per unit of GDP" earlier. That's indeed target. Unemployment rate target is 5.5 percent, not 6.5 percent. So B is partially incorrect: unemployment target wrong. So B not right.

Option C: "China has increased its GDP volume by 30 trillion yuan over the past five years, and the 14th Five-Year Plan is the first five years in which China has become a modern socialist country in all respects." Report says GDP increased from <70 trillion yuan to >100 trillion yuan. That's an increase of ~30 trillion? Yes difference ~30. That matches "increased its GDP volume by 30 trillion yuan over the past five years." Then: "the 14th Five-Year Plan is the first five years in which China has became a modern socialist country in all respects." The report: "The period covered by the 14th Five-Year Plan will be the first five years in which we embark on a new journey to build China into a modern socialist country in all respects." That is exactly stated. So Option C seems correct.

Option D: "China has made a tax deduction of 85 percent on enterprises' R&D costs, and China will continue to raise this percentage to 100 percent for manufacturing enterprises." Report says: "We will continue to implement the policy of granting an extra tax deduction of 75 percent on enterprises’ R&D costs, and we will raise this to 100 percent for manufacturing enterprises." So the 75 percent not 85. So D incorrect.

Thus C is correct. So answer: \boxed{C}.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>\boxed{C}
